name: MLA-NoPE + QK-norm
tagline: Latent attention without rotary positions; order comes only from the causal mask.
description: The same latent ranks, heads and value width as MLA, but the 128-dimensional query and key content carries no rotary part and there is no shared RoPE key, so positions enter only through causal masking. The per-head QK RMSNorm with gain 1.2 acts on the content queries and keys.
paperTitle: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
mechanism: Query latent rank 768; key/value latent rank 256; no RoPE key
Per-head QK RMSNorm × 1.2; full causal attention in 26 layers
limitations: A control for MLA's decoupled RoPE, not a published model. The QK normalization departs from DeepSeek-V2. Latent-cache decoding is not implemented, so no KV-cache saving is claimed. Value embeddings are disabled, and the matching multi-head control without them has not been trained. Single seed 42; trained from the frozen Others branch, not yet ported to the current code.
